verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a SaaS cap-table platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no bulk-action capability, such as multi-select edits, batch grant issuance, or bulk terminations. The documented actions are single-item workflows (e.g., terminating one stakeholder via Actions, merging duplicate stakeholders), and the one-time Excel and Carta migration imports are onboarding features, not bulk operations a user can run over many items.
